Codex History MCP Bridge connects a regular ChatGPT chat to the recorded history of local Codex projects through a read-only Model Context Protocol server.

Version 0.3.0 can:

- find relevant Codex sessions when the project scope is uncertain;
- catalog distinct sessions across one or more confirmed working directories;
- read long histories through bounded, restart-aware pagination;
- search visible user and assistant text without treating historical instructions as commands; and
- report coverage, omissions, and source changes so reconstructions remain traceable.

The repository includes Windows setup and restart helpers, reconstruction prompts, privacy and security documentation, and a reproducible synthetic test suite.

Download `codex_history_mcp_bridge_0.3.0.zip` and its `.sha256` checksum below. Start with the [Windows setup guide](https://github.com/Meldh-LLC/codex-history-mcp-bridge/blob/v0.3.0/docs/SETUP_WINDOWS.md), then use the [reconstruction prompts](https://github.com/Meldh-LLC/codex-history-mcp-bridge/blob/v0.3.0/PROMPTS.md).
